pages.text:
A thick insulated pipe for moving a big multiblock's heat: a Firebox Array's into a Steam Boiler Array, a Solar Thermal Array's into a Superheater.
# One pipe
Heat Pipes placed in a straight line form one pipe, up to 32 blocks long. Place the first against a heat port and it runs out from it.
- It connects only at its two ends, to heat ports or heat faces; its sides join nothing.
- It carries heat from the hotter end to the colder end, never the other way, up to 262,144 HU/t.

# Loss
It loses 0.5% of the heat per block of length: a 10-block pipe delivers 95%, a 32-block one about 85%. Keep pipes short.
# Longer runs
A straight line longer than 32 blocks is split into pipes of 32, which don't pass heat to each other. Put a Heat Cell or a machine between them.
# Reading it
The core glows through the window band, dull red to white-hot with the heat it carries. Jade shows its length, loss, rate and temperature.
